verdicts.statement: An SAP system landscape is defined by business and functional requirements.
verdicts.reason: The context states that landscape design depends on business requirements and that business and functional requirements determine the SAP solutions and how applications run.

verdicts.statement: Business and functional requirements determine the SAP solutions used in an SAP system landscape.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that business and functional requirements determine the SAP solutions powered by SAP HANA Database Server or SAP NetWeaver Application Server.

verdicts.statement: Business and functional requirements determine how applications run on the available infrastructure.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that business and functional requirements determine the SAP solutions and therefore how applications run on the available infrastructure.

verdicts.statement: An SAP system landscape is a group of two or more SAP systems.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly defines an SAP landscape as a group of two or more SAP Systems.

verdicts.statement: The SAP systems in an SAP system landscape typically serve development, quality assurance and testing, and production purposes.
verdicts.reason: The context states that an SAP landscape usually includes development, quality and test, and production systems.

verdicts.statement: The design of an SAP system landscape depends on the requirements of the business.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that landscape design is up to each business and depends on business requirements.

verdicts.statement: The design of an SAP system landscape includes system instances and tracks.
verdicts.reason: The context describes SAP instances grouped into SAP systems and those systems organized into a landscape with one or multiple tracks.
